synopsis: While on a regular school day, Tsukuru along with his classmates got transported to another world. However, at the other side of the summoning there was a hero's auction, where each nation would bid for the heroes to defeat the demon kings of each territories. title: Maou no Atelier Kiseki no Accessory no Tsukurikata

titleNative: 魔王のアトリエ　奇跡のアクセサリの作り方
synopsis: Demon Lord Yami, exhausted by the prolonged war, begs Hero Lux to "kill her." But the hero couldn't bring himself to kill the lonely girl. And Yami fell in love for the first time. Lux faked the Demon Lord's death and ended the war. However, their peaceful life together didn't last long, and Lux ​​died of illness. In her despair, Yami delivered his ashes to his hometown, where she found his younger brother, Ray, who bore a striking resemblance to him. With nowhere else to go, Yami hides her true identity and takes up residence in the accessory workshop run by Ray. Eventually, she realizes that the Demon Lord's magic brings about mysterious miracles for the owners of the accessories—… A story of rebirth unfolds in a world without a hero. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Wicked Spot
synopsis: After spending over a century hiding in the shadows, powerful sorceress Sadako stumbles upon the dazzling world of social media and decides to post her way into her first real contact with humanity. She soon becomes an internet sensation, attracting a huge following of doting fans—and shocks them all by announcing she is a witch. The big reveal turns one follower called Hanako, a lonely young woman with seemingly inhuman strength and a curious resistance to magic, into a dedicated hater, and inadvertently sends them both on a whirlwind adventure beyond their wildest dreams! (Source: Kodansha USA)
